name: app-shater-control-panel-structure-tablet-with-linked-menu-list
title: Shater 'Control Panel' structure: tablet dashboard linked to a vertical list of admin sections
whatItIs: A light page with a big orange-and-navy Arabic 'لوحة التحكم' (Control Panel) title, a hand holding a tablet showing the admin dashboard, an explanatory Arabic paragraph, and a vertical list of pill-labelled sections (Dashboard, Customers, Craftsmen, Verification Requests, Services, Departments, Withdrawal Methods, Refund Requests) each linked by a dotted line, closed with '+70 screens' claim.
whatItMeans: Reassuringly thorough; listing every admin section with a line to the hub proves depth of scope.
techniques: List every module as a pill linked to the hub screen.
State a total screen count as a scale claim.
Use a tablet-in-hand mockup for the main view.

vocabulary.definition: Every functional section of an admin system.
A number used to show a project's size.
